contract.task: Predict the sensory quality score of Portuguese Vinho Verde wine from physicochemical tests.
contract.context: wine_type identifies red or white wine. Other fields describe acidity, sugar, chlorides, sulfur dioxide, density, pH, sulphates and alcohol, retained on their original laboratory-data scales. Predict an ordered quality score, not a wine class.
contract.group_note: Identical physicochemical inputs and wine type; bottle IDs are unavailable.
contract.split: group_by_identical_inputs; red and white are one dataset family

grouping_rule: Identical physicochemical inputs and wine type; bottle IDs are unavailable. Identical prepared inputs are additionally unioned to prevent duplicate-input leakage.
deduplication_policy: One example per identical task/input/label; source_refs and duplicate_count preserve multiplicity. Different labels retained.
missing_policy: null; no statistical imputation; two nonpositive Abalone heights and ten nonpositive Metro Kelvin temperatures are converted to null in their respective sources.
split_policy: UNASSIGNED: choose dataset-family holdouts and appropriate grouped/chronological splits before training. group_id prevents known overlap but does not prove independence.

license.name: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the UCI dataset page

citation_paper.title: Modeling wine preferences by data mining from physicochemical properties
citation_paper.authors: P. Cortez, A. Cerdeira, Fernando Almeida, Telmo Matos, J. Reis

quality_findings.detail: Red=1599; white=4898. Treat as one source family.
Different targets for the same input can represent noise or unobserved variables; they are not averaged or deleted.
Identical task/input/label examples are stored once with duplicate_count. This is a deduplication policy, not proof that all originals are erroneous.
Conservative decimal precision cap; original source files unchanged. All changes and old/new IDs retained in numeric_precision_changes.jsonl.gz.

source_values_policy: No learned feature scaling, target normalization, truncation, oversampling or label clipping; unknown physical units explicitly identified. Prepared numeric values now follow significant_digits_12_v1; exact originals remain in raw and the versioned history.

numeric_precision.rule: Non-integral finite floats rounded to at most 12 significant decimal digits; integers, null and strings unchanged; no fixed decimal-place rounding or clipping.

prepared_profile_scope: Final normalized, eligible, deduplicated output records. Raw profile retains the original source-table scope.
distribution_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, gzip compressed, at most 100000 records per shard
